items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: I used to play with Ernest. I was playing with Ernest.

ctx.x: No, Ernest Jodtonio. They don't mention them in the book. I don't think you could pick up a book right now and find his name. It's in here. That he had the first good band.

But it's in French. It doesn't say that. Oh, I know him. I don't think it says that. I can't read French myself. Oh, it's in French, the book? Yeah, but it tells about, you're talking about Ernest Jodtonio and Tony Jodtonio both.
